about.title: Watsonville Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Watsonville sees real traffic pressure along corridors like Main Street, Freedom Boulevard, Green Valley Road, and Airport Boulevard, with public records showing 106 injury collisions and 129 people hurt in the most recent year on file. Crashes tend to cluster on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m., when commuters, farmworkers, and weekend traffic overlap. If you were injured in one of these collisions, the period right after matters: insurance adjusters may call quickly, and what you say can affect your claim. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves — we're a free service that connects injured Watsonville residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate what happened, help preserve evidence like photos and witness contacts, and handle communication with insurers so you're not navigating it alone. There's no obligation to move forward, and no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Watsonville Residents Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but claims against a government entity (like a city or county road issue) can require notice in as little as six months. An attorney can help you figure out which deadline applies to your situation.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Automatically Sink Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still pursue compensation even if you're partly responsible for the crash — your recovery is simply reduced by your share of fault. This matters on multi-vehicle corridors like Airport Boulevard where fault can be disputed.

items.title: No Cap Means Your Full Story Counts
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. An independent attorney can help document how the injury has actually affected your daily life, not just your medical bills.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions in ways that can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can communicate on your behalf so your words aren't twisted against you.

items.question: What if my crash happened on Freedom Boulevard or another busy Watsonville corridor?
items.answer: High-traffic roads like Freedom Boulevard, Main Street, and Green Valley Road often mean more witnesses and more potential evidence, such as nearby business cameras. An attorney can help track down that evidence quickly before it's lost or overwritten.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and the independent attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. There's no obligation to move forward after your initial conversation.
